situation: 2 years at a logistics startup. When my lead left in March I took over warehouse scheduling and cut overtime by about $40k. I'm on $72k, the market for this role looks like $85k. Need to message my manager Kevin on Slack to set up the talk.
reply: Hi Kevin, could we set aside 30 minutes next week to talk about my role and compensation? The scope has grown a lot since I took over warehouse scheduling in March, and I'd like to give it proper time rather than squeeze it into our regular 1:1. Tuesday or Wednesday afternoon both work for me.
note: Book first, ask in the room: bring the $40k overtime saving and the $85k figure to the meeting, not to Slack.

situation: Hatte heute mein Gespräch mit meiner Chefin Frau Albers wegen der Beförderung zur Teamleiterin ab 1. Januar. Sie will das mit dem Geschäftsführer Herrn Brandt besprechen, hat aber kein Datum genannt. Ich (Jana Keller) habe dieses Jahr die drei neuen Kolleginnen eingearbeitet und will eine Follow-up-Mail schreiben.
reply: Liebe Frau Albers, vielen Dank für das offene Gespräch heute. Zur Bestätigung: Sie besprechen die Beförderung zur Teamleiterin zum 1. Januar mit Herrn Brandt. Könnten Sie mir bis zum 30. Oktober Bescheid geben? Bis Freitag, 9. Oktober, schicke ich Ihnen noch die Übersicht zur Einarbeitung der drei neuen Kolleginnen, falls sie für das Gespräch hilft. Viele Grüße, Jana Keller
note: Das Datum für die Antwort steht in der Mail, auch wenn es im Gespräch gefehlt hat.

situation: I'm a UX designer and asked my manager Nadia for 8% after leading the checkout redesign. She said 'not this cycle, let's see next year' without saying what would change it. Our next review is in March and I don't want to just drop it.
reply: Understood, Nadia, and thanks for being straight with me. So I'm clear: what would need to be true for the 8% to be a yes? Could we write down the two or three things you'd want to see from me and look at it again in the March review? I'll put a note in both our calendars.
note: A vague 'next year' becomes written criteria and a date. If you still can't get either, that tells you the ceiling here.

situation: My company just published salary bands. I'm a senior analyst on $68,000 and the band for my level is $74,000 to $88,000. I lead the pricing model now and want to ask for $78,000. Want to raise it with my manager Laura without sounding accusatory.
reply: Hi Laura, now that the pay bands are published, I noticed my salary of $68,000 sits below the $74,000 to $88,000 band for senior analyst. I'd like to understand how my pay was set, and whether we can bring it to $78,000, given I now own the pricing model. Could we find 30 minutes next week to talk it through? Thursday or Friday afternoon both work.
note: Anchor on the published band and your scope, never on a colleague's pay, and name the number you want.

situation: 我在一家跨境电商公司做数据分析三年，月薪1.8万。去年搭了广告投放的归因看板，获客成本降了约15%，现在也在带新人。上周拿到另一家公司2.4万的offer，要在10月12号前回复。我更想留下，想跟领导王姐谈调到2.3万；如果这边调不了，我是真的会去。怎么提这个offer才不像威胁？
reply: 王姐，我很喜欢现在的工作，也想在这个团队长期做下去。过去一年我搭了广告投放的归因看板，投放组的获客成本降了大约15%，新人的数据培训现在也是我在带。坦白说，上周我拿到了另一家公司月薪2.4万的offer，但我更想留下，所以想先跟您谈：能不能把我的月薪调到2.3万？需要什么材料往上申请，我下周都可以准备。那边要我10月12日前答复，所以想请您10月9日周五前给我一个结果。
note: 外部offer只提一次，语气平静，先说想留下；只有真的会去才提，否则就别拿它当筹码。

situation: Sous chef at a 30-seat restaurant, 3 years. Since our head chef left in June I've written the menus and done all the ordering, food cost went from 34% to 29%. Yesterday I asked the owner, Marco, for the head chef title and $62k (I'm on $51k); he got defensive and it ended badly. I want to text him to pick it up again calmly, Wednesday or Thursday around 2 before service.
reply: Hi Marco, thanks for hearing me out yesterday. I know it got tense at the end, and I'd like to pick it up again calmly. I love this kitchen and want to keep building it with you. Since June I've written the menus and done all the ordering, and food cost has gone from 34% to 29%, which is why I'm asking for the head chef title and $62k. Could we sit down next Wednesday or Thursday around 2, before service?
note: After a tense first talk, don't drop it or argue by text: acknowledge it calmly, restate the case and the number in one line, and book a fresh conversation.

situation: In March my manager Rob said if I delivered the data platform migration I'd be put up for Staff Engineer in the fall cycle. It went live on August 18. Now he says I also need to 'show more cross-org influence'. It feels like the goalposts moved. We have a 1:1 on Thursday.
reply: Thanks for being straight with me about where it stands. In March we agreed that shipping the data platform migration was the bar for Staff this fall, and it went live on 18 August. Since the criteria have shifted, could we write down exactly what's needed now, what cross-org influence looks like in practice, and the date you'll decide, so we're both working to the same list? I'd like it settled in time for the fall cycle.
note: Name the original agreement as a fact, not an accusation, and get the new bar in writing with a date. If it moves again, that tells you the ceiling here.

situation: 我在一家设计公司做了四年，今年三月开始带小吴和小赵两个新人，审他们的稿，上季度组里准时交付率从80%提到了95%。上周刘总说给我升设计组长，但工资不变，明年再看。我月薪1.5万，公司其他组长大概1.8万，明天约了他谈。
reply: 刘总，谢谢您给我这个机会，组长这个角色我很想做好。从三月开始我已经在带小吴和小赵，他们的稿子都是我审，上个季度组里的准时交付率从80%提到了95%。升组长之后责任和范围都变了，我希望薪资同步调整到1.8万，和公司其他组长一致。如果现在调不了，我们能不能把调薪的条件和时间定下来，写下来各留一份？
note: 晋升是头衔、职责加薪资；只给头衔时不要直接接受，先谈薪资，谈不下来就把条件和日期写下来。

situation: My new manager Aisha started six weeks ago and doesn't know my history. I'm a customer success lead on $64k; since January I've owned our 14 enterprise accounts (about $2.1M a year) with a 96% renewal rate, and I wrote the onboarding playbook the team uses. Similar roles pay about $70k to $78k. I want $72k before the November review cycle. We meet Thursday.
reply: Thanks for making time, Aisha. I really like this team and want to keep growing here, and since you're new I wanted to give you the full picture before the November cycle. Since January I've owned our 14 enterprise accounts, about $2.1M a year, with a 96% renewal rate, and I wrote the onboarding playbook the team uses now. Based on that scope and what CS leads are paid in the market, I'd like to move from $64,000 to $72,000. What would you need from me to make that case in November?
note: A new manager can't vouch for your history, so give her the case in numbers she can repeat upstairs, and send it in writing the same day.

situation: I've been a nanny for the Carters' two kids, Leo (8) and Maya (6), for two years at $20 an hour. Since September I also do school pickup and homework help, and Maya's reading has come on a lot. Local rates for that scope are $22 to $25. I want to ask their mum, Lucy, for $23 an hour from November. We've set up a chat Thursday evening.
reply: Lucy, I really love working with you and the kids and I'd like to keep doing it for a long time. Since September I've taken on school pickup and homework as well as childcare, and Maya's reading has really come on. Based on that and what nannies with this scope earn around here, I'd like to move to $23 an hour from November. What do you think, and if it's not possible now, what would it take?
note: A household employer is still an employer: commitment first, scope and results as evidence, one number, and an invitation to the path.

situation: 我在一家SaaS公司做测试工程师三年，月薪1.6万，去年搭了接口自动化测试，回归时间从两天缩到半天。最近在带一个同职级的新同事，无意中知道他月薪1.9万。招聘网站上同职级大概1.8万到2万。明天约了领导陈总谈，不想拿同事说事。
reply: 陈总，谢谢您抽时间。我很喜欢这里的工作，也想在测试这块继续做深。过去一年我搭了接口自动化测试，回归时间从两天缩到了半天；这个季度的新同事也是我在带。我看了一下，同职级测试工程师的市场薪资在1.8万到2万之间，我希望把月薪调到1.9万。如果现在调不了，需要满足哪些条件、什么时候能再看？
note: 同事的工资只是提醒你该谈了，不是论据；在谈话里只讲自己的成果、职级和市场数据，永远不点名比较。

situation: In August my manager Tom agreed my raise from $70k to $78k from September 1, and HR sent a confirmation letter on August 21. My September payslip still shows $70k, and Tom has said 'HR is on it' twice in two weeks. I want to follow up in writing without sounding pushy.
reply: Hi Tom, following up on my raise to $78,000 from 1 September, confirmed in HR's letter of 21 August. My September payslip still shows $70,000, so I was paid about $667 short before tax. Could you or HR confirm by Wednesday 7 October that the October payroll will include the new salary and the September back pay? Happy to forward the letter and the payslip if that helps.
note: Once a raise is agreed, the follow-up is admin: the letter, the gap, one dated ask. If October passes, go to HR directly with both documents.

situation: I asked my manager Denise for $82k (I'm on $70k), the market rate for this scope, after taking over our two biggest client accounts. She emailed back today offering $75k from January, saying it's what she could get approved. Our next review is in July. I want to take it but not drop the rest.
reply: Thanks, Denise, I appreciate you getting it approved and coming back so quickly. I'm glad to accept $75,000 from January. I'd still like to close the gap to $82,000, since that's where this scope sits in the market. Could we agree in writing what you'd need to see from me by the July review to get there?
note: Accept what's on the table, keep your number, and turn the rest into written criteria with a date.

situation: I came back in August from nine months of parental leave. Before I left, my manager Sophie said I was 'on track' for Senior Account Manager, but the spring promotion cycle ran while I was out and I wasn't considered. I want to book a talk about it without sounding resentful.
reply: Hi Sophie, now that I'm properly settled back in, could we find 30 minutes in the next two weeks to talk about my path to Senior Account Manager? Before my leave we'd agreed I was on track, and since the spring cycle ran while I was out, I'd like us to pin down what's needed for the next one and when it is. Tuesday or Thursday afternoon would suit me.
note: Book the talk about the path, not the grievance, and bring your pre-leave results to the meeting. If the path keeps moving, check your company's leave policy and talk to HR.

situation: Llevo cuatro años trabajando en la ferretería de mi tío Paco en Valencia y cobro 1.450 euros al mes. Desde enero llevo yo los pedidos a proveedores y la tienda online, que ya es el 20% de las ventas. Hemos quedado el sábado después de cerrar y quiero pedirle 1.700 euros desde noviembre sin que se convierta en una conversación de familia.
reply: Paco, hoy quiero hablar contigo como jefe, no como sobrino. Me gusta mucho la tienda y quiero seguir aquí muchos años. Desde enero llevo los pedidos a proveedores y la tienda online, que ya es el 20% de las ventas. Por eso te pido pasar de 1.450 a 1.700 euros al mes a partir de noviembre. Si ahora no es posible, ¿qué necesitarías ver y cuándo lo podemos revisar?
note: Con un familiar como jefe, separa los papeles en la primera frase y apóyate solo en el trabajo, nunca en la familia.

situation: My director Hannah just asked if I'll take over the Northern region team when Raj leaves on October 16, on top of my own team, so 12 people instead of 6. I'm a regional manager on $95k and want to say yes, but the doubled scope should come with a title and pay change.
reply: Hi Hannah, thanks for trusting me with this, and yes, I'd like to take on the Northern team. Going from 6 people to 12 across two regions is a real change in the role, so alongside the handover plan I'd like us to talk about the title and pay that go with it. Could we find 30 minutes before Raj leaves on Friday 16 October? Thursday or Friday afternoon next week both work for me.
note: The moment scope is added is the best time to ask: say yes, name the change, and book the pay talk before the handover. Bring the number to the meeting.

situation: I'm a programme coordinator at a small charity on £31,000. In July my director Helen said salaries are frozen until April because of a funding cut. Since my colleague Sam left in July and wasn't replaced, I've run the volunteer programme (60 volunteers) on top of my own job. I'd like the title Programme and Volunteer Manager now and £35,000 from April, agreed in writing.
reply: Hi Helen, could we find 30 minutes next week to talk about my role? I love working here and want to keep growing with the charity. Since Sam left in July I've been running the volunteer programme, all 60 volunteers, alongside my coordinator work. I understand salaries are frozen until April, so I'd like to propose the title Programme and Volunteer Manager now, and a written agreement that my salary moves to £35,000 in April. If that's not possible, I'd like to understand what would be.
note: When cash is frozen, ask for the title now and lock the number in writing for the date the freeze ends.

situation: I'm Leila, a marketing analyst at a logistics company for two years, on $72k. My manager Tom has my annual review on Thursday Oct 8. Since my last raise I took over the $400k-a-year paid ads budget after a colleague left, and similar roles are posting at $82k to $88k. I want to email him before the review asking for $85k.
reply: Hi Tom, I'm looking forward to Thursday's review, and I've really enjoyed this year on the team. Since I took over the $400k paid ads budget, my role has grown a lot, and similar roles are currently posting at $82k to $88k. I'd like to discuss moving my salary from $72k to $85k. Could we make that part of Thursday's conversation? Thanks, Leila
note: Sent ahead so Tom can check budget before the meeting instead of reacting on the spot.

situation: I'm the first engineer at a 7-person startup, two years in, on $85k; similar roles pay around $110k. I built the billing system that now handles all our revenue, and I've hired and onboarded the other three engineers. Our founder, Dana, told the team last month we have 16 months of runway, so I want to ask for $100k but I'm open to extra equity if cash is tight.
reply: Dana, I love building this with you and I want to be here for the next stage. In two years I've built the billing system that now runs all our revenue, and I've hired and onboarded the other three engineers. Similar roles pay around $110k, so I'd like to move from $85k to $100k. I know we have 16 months of runway, so if that's too much cash right now, I'm open to a mix of salary and extra equity. What would it take to get there, and by when?
note: Name the number first and offer equity as a route to it, not a replacement. Get any equity terms in writing and check what they are actually worth before agreeing.

situation: I'm a Team Lead I in customer support on $66k. I asked my manager Greg for $72k after cutting our ticket backlog by 40% this year, and since March I've also run the weekend rota for both support teams. He says I'm already at the top of the Team Lead I band ($58k to $66k), so there's nothing he can do. Our next review cycle is in January.
reply: Thanks for explaining the band, Greg, that helps. If I'm at the top of Team Lead I, it sounds like the real question is whether my role now fits Team Lead II. This year I've cut the ticket backlog by 40%, and since March I've run the weekend rota for both support teams. Could we go through the Team Lead II criteria together, agree what's still missing, and aim for a decision in the January cycle?
note: A band ceiling is a question about level, not a no: move the ask up a level and get the gap written down with a date.

situation: 我在一家物业公司做客服主管三年，月薪一直是7500，三年没调过。今年接手了阳光花园和锦绣苑两个新小区的投诉处理，平均结案时间从5天缩短到2天。想在微信上约经理周姐单独谈，目标是月薪8500。
reply: 周姐，想跟您约20分钟单独聊聊我的岗位和薪资，下周四或周五下午您看哪个方便？我挺喜欢现在这份工作，也想在这边长期干下去。简单说一下：今年我接手了阳光花园和锦绣苑的投诉处理，平均结案时间从5天缩短到了2天；我入职三年月薪一直是7500，想跟您谈谈调到8500。见面时我把具体数据带上。
note: 预约消息里就给出数字和一条证据，领导有时间提前准备，不算突然袭击。

situation: 我是运营主管，月薪1.4万。部门经理何姐8月初休产假，老板周总让我代理部门经理，预计到明年1月，现在我管8个人、负责部门预算和每周的周报。公司其他部门经理月薪大约2万。明天下午约了周总谈，想要代理期间每月4000元补贴，从10月开始。
reply: 周总，谢谢您让我代理何姐的工作，这两个月我学到很多，也想把部门带好。从8月起，我在原来的运营工作之外，还管着8个人，负责部门预算和每周的周报。代理要到明年1月，参照其他部门经理的薪资水平，我希望代理期间每月有4000元的代理补贴，从10月开始。如果这个数现在批不下来，需要满足什么条件、什么时候能定，我们可以一起定下来。
note: 代理是临时的范围扩大：要一个有起止时间的补贴比要永久调薪更容易批；谈完当天发微信把结论和日期写下来。

situation: 物流会社で入社5年目の主任です。今年4月から在庫管理システムの移行を担当し、棚卸差異を年間1,200万円から300万円に減らしました。新人2名の指導もしています。10月5日（月）に田中部長との面談を取ってもらったので、来年4月の係長昇格をお願いしたいです。
reply: 本日はお時間をいただきありがとうございます。この会社での仕事にやりがいを感じており、これからもここで役割を広げていきたいと考えています。今年4月から在庫管理システムの移行を担当し、棚卸差異を年間1,200万円から300万円まで減らすことができました。また、新人2名の指導も担当しております。そこで、来年4月の係長昇格をご検討いただけないでしょうか。もし現時点で難しければ、何が足りないのか、いつまでに何を示せばよいのかを教えていただけますと幸いです。
note: 面談では控えめでも具体的に：数字で成果を示し、昇格と道筋を一度ずつお願いする。給与等級も変わるか確認し、合意内容は当日メールで残す。

situation: I've worked at a garden centre for three years on $17.50 an hour. In April everyone got the same 3% cost-of-living raise. Since June I've been the Saturday keyholder, opening up and cashing up, and I trained the five seasonal staff this summer. I asked my manager Brenda for $19.50 and she said 'you already got a raise in April'.
reply: I know, and I appreciated the April raise. That was the cost-of-living one everyone got, though, and what I'm asking about is the extra work since June: opening up and cashing up as Saturday keyholder, and training the five seasonal staff this summer. That's why I'm asking for $19.50 an hour. If that's not possible now, what would it take, and when could we look at it again?
note: Separate the across-the-board raise from a raise for added scope, then ask for the path, not just a yes.

situation: My manager Paula moves to another team on Monday Nov 16, and her Team Manager role is being advertised externally. I've been her deputy for 18 months and ran our team of 9 on my own during her six weeks away this summer, including the July close. I want to message the hiring manager, our director Sam, to be considered.
reply: Hi Sam, I saw the Team Manager role opening when Paula moves on Monday 16 November, and I'd like to be considered for it. I've been Paula's deputy for 18 months and ran the team of 9 on my own during her six weeks away this summer, including the July close. Could we find 30 minutes next week to talk about the role and what you're looking for? I'll apply through the posting too, so I'm in the same process as everyone else.
note: An internal opening: book the conversation, lead with scope you've already carried, and don't ask to skip the process.

situation: 我们公司去年被现在的集团收购，我是原公司的区域销售经理，月薪1.6万。集团原有的区域销售经理同岗位月薪大约1.9万，HR说过“会逐步统一”，但一直没给时间。今年我负责的华北区回款率从88%提到了96%，还在天津新签了两个客户。下周二约了上级钱总谈，想从明年1月起调到1.9万。
reply: 钱总，谢谢您抽时间。并入集团这一年我做得很投入，也想在这边长期发展。今年华北区的回款率从88%提到了96%，天津还新签了两个客户。集团里同岗位的区域销售经理月薪大约是1.9万，我现在是1.6万，HR之前也说过会逐步统一。我希望从明年1月起调到1.9万。如果1月做不到，能不能把统一的时间和条件定下来，我们写下来各留一份？
note: 并购后的薪资差距按岗位讲，不点名比较；“会统一”要追问到具体日期，谈完当天发微信把结论确认一遍。

situation: On September 3 I asked my manager Elena to move my salary from $68k to $76k after I took over the partner onboarding programme. She said she'd talk to finance and come back to me by September 18. It's now October 2, she hasn't mentioned it, and our 1:1 last week was cancelled. I want to follow up on Slack without nagging.
reply: Hi Elena, following up on our 3 September conversation about moving my salary from $68,000 to $76,000. You mentioned you'd speak to finance and come back to me by 18 September, and I know the last few weeks have been busy. Could you let me know where it stands, or when you expect an answer? If it's easier to talk it through, I'd be glad to find 20 minutes next week.
note: Silence is neither a yes nor a no: restate the number and the date she gave, and ask for a new date. If that slips too, ask what would make it a yes.

situation: 我在一家奶茶连锁的门店做店长两年，月薪6500。今年把门店月营业额从18万做到了24万，还带出了两个能独立开店的店员。跟老板陈哥提想调到7500，他说：“给你加了，其他店长也会来要。”
reply: 陈哥，我理解您的顾虑。我不是跟其他店长比，是按我这家店的结果来谈：月营业额从18万做到了24万，还带出了两个能独立开店的店员。其他店长做到同样的结果，按同样的标准加，我觉得也公平。所以我还是希望调到7500；如果现在不行，能不能定一个标准，比如营业额保持在多少、什么时候可以调？
note: 对“别人也会来要”的顾虑，把加薪绑在可复制的结果标准上，而不是当成例外。

situation: I'm a school office administrator on Grade 4 of our pay scale. Since January I've managed the school's £180,000 budget and supervised two part-time assistants, which matches the Grade 5 job description, not mine. The scale itself is fixed, but regrading requests go through the head teacher, Mrs Patel, and we've booked 20 minutes on Tuesday before the spring review.
reply: Mrs Patel, thank you for making time. I really enjoy running the office and I want to keep growing here. Since January I've managed the school's £180,000 budget and supervised our two part-time assistants, and when I compared my work with the job descriptions, it matches Grade 5 rather than Grade 4. I know the pay scale itself is fixed, so I'm asking whether you'd submit a regrading request for my role before the spring review. If you see it differently, could we go through the Grade 5 description together and agree what's missing?
note: On a fixed pay scale the ask is a regrade, not a raise: match your duties to the next grade's description, then confirm in writing what she agreed.

situation: 我在一家医药公司做市场专员四年，月薪1.3万。上个月市场主管的位置空出来，我申请了，结果公司外招了一位新主管，下周一入职。想在微信上约部门总监郑总聊聊我差在哪、下一步怎么走，短期目标是明年升高级专员，月薪调到1.5万。
reply: 郑总，想约您30分钟聊一聊我的发展，下周四或周五下午您看哪个方便？这次主管没选我，我想听听您真实的看法：我离主管还差哪些。我还是很想在这个团队长期做下去，短期内希望明年能升高级专员，月薪从1.3万调到1.5万。见面时我们能不能把需要做到的几条和时间定下来？
note: 没被选上之后不评价招聘结果，把谈话变成书面的标准和日期；谈完当天发微信把结论确认一遍。

situation: Je suis Claire, comptable chez un éditeur de logiciels, à 46 000 € brut par an. Depuis février je gère seule la clôture mensuelle des filiales belge et suisse, et le délai de clôture est passé de 8 à 5 jours ; les postes équivalents sont affichés entre 50 000 et 54 000 €. Ma manager, Sophie, est à Montréal, nous avons un entretien en visio mardi 6 octobre et je veux demander 52 000 €.
reply: Merci de prendre ce temps, Sophie. J'aime beaucoup mon travail ici et j'ai envie de continuer à évoluer dans l'équipe. Depuis février, je gère seule la clôture mensuelle des filiales belge et suisse, et le délai de clôture est passé de 8 à 5 jours. Au vu de ce périmètre et des postes équivalents, affichés entre 50 000 et 54 000 €, je souhaiterais passer de 46 000 à 52 000 € brut par an. Si ce n'est pas possible tout de suite, que faudrait-il réunir, et pour quand ?
note: En visio avec une manager à distance, même déroulé : des chiffres qu'elle pourra relayer, un montant, puis un mail récapitulatif le jour même.

situation: 我今年5月入职一家广告公司做文案，月薪1.2万，试用期到10月31日，offer里写着“转正后根据考核结果调整薪资”。试用期里我独立负责了两个客户的月度推文，其中一个客户续签了一年。想在微信上约组长林姐，在转正谈话里提调到1.35万。
reply: 林姐，我的试用期10月31日到期，想约您30分钟聊聊转正，10月中旬您看哪天方便？这几个月我很喜欢这里的工作，也想长期做下去。offer里写着转正后根据考核调整薪资，所以想一起谈谈：试用期里我独立负责了两个客户的月度推文，其中一个客户续签了一年，我希望转正后月薪调到1.35万。见面时我把具体的材料带上。
note: 转正是offer里写明的调薪节点：提前约时间，带一个数字和成果，谈完当天用微信把结论确认一遍。
